Claimed installed-detail desktop and 744px observations were not independently inspected; prepared images concern child chat cards, and video preparation failed. Inspection now awaits catalog enrichment and selects its identity from source.packageName or inventory packageName. management-service.ts:608 shows that packageName can be an npm package name, without a canonical ClawHub relationship.
Remote latency reaches local inspection: The new awaited detail fetch completes before plugins.inspect responds. The ClawHub client uses a 30-second default request timeout, so catching rejection does not preserve immediate local inspection during a slow request.
Installed artwork discovery regression: The replacement publisher icon lacks data-plugin-icon-id. plugins-page.ts:225 still gathers that marker, and PluginIconController.sync skips plugins outside the gathered set, preventing artwork loading on direct detail navigation. | | **Findings** | 3 actionable findings | [P2] [P2] Preserve canonical ClawHub identity in the deployed result
[P2] [P2] Keep optional catalog reads off the inspection response

These detail pages combine that local information with optional ClawHub descriptions while retaining existing configuration and lifecycle controls. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Installed plugin metadata] --> B[Gateway inspection] C[Operator configuration] --> B B --> D[Installed detail tabs] E[ClawHub package metadata] --> D D --> F[Capabilities and descriptions] D --> G[Configuration and lifecycle controls] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **\[P2\] Preserve canonical ClawHub identity in the deployed result (P2)** - For npm or local installations, `source.packageName` and inventory `packageName` do not establish a ClawHub counterpart. A namesake at the same version can attach unrelated publisher, official-badge, README, and security information. This prior finding remains in the pinned head; preserve the verified canonical-identity repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/142782 through the documented combined deployment. - [ ] **\[P2\] Keep optional catalog reads off the inspection response (P2)** - The handler waits for remote detail requests before returning already available local inspection. Slow ClawHub requests therefore delay capabilities and access information; catching errors only helps after the requests finish. The child PR already separates these reads, so include that repair in the deployable result rather than deploying this intermediate handler. - [ ] **\[P3\] Preserve the installed icon discovery marker (P3)** - Replacing `renderArtTile` removes `data-plugin-icon-id`, while the page still uses that marker to select installed icons for fetching. Opening an installed detail URL directly consequently leaves the generic box even when artwork exists. The child restores the marker; retain that fix in the combined deployment. - [ ] **Resolve security concern: Marketplace trust information can describe a different package** - An npm/local package name is used as a ClawHub identity without a proven counterpart, and the resulting official badge and security status are shown beside the installed plugin. The child PR's canonical-identity repair addresses this presentation risk. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - The combined-deployment commitment is documented, but this review has not validated a final landing artifact containing the child repairs; deploying this intermediate head would retain the reported defects. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - The claimed desktop and narrow-screen installed-detail captures could not be inspected from the prepared artifacts. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - Validate the final combined landing with the three verified repairs from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/142782 included; do not deploy this intermediate head independently. - [ ] **Add data-model compatibility proof** - Confirm migration or upgrade compatibility proof before merge. ## Findings - [P2] [P2] Preserve canonical ClawHub identity in the deployed result — `src/gateway/server-methods/plugins.ts:81-85` - [P2] [P2] Keep optional catalog reads off the inspection response — `src/gateway/server-methods/plugins.ts:85-95` - [P3] [P3] Preserve the installed icon discovery marker — `ui/src/pages/plugins/settings-view.ts:655-658` - [medium] Marketplace trust information can describe a different package — `src/gateway/server-methods/plugins.ts:83`
